accent.$description: Project accent alias. Keep the underlying Canon token as the source of truth.

pressure.$description: Live pressure and decision-point alias. Pair color with a text label.

surface.$description: Default overlay surface alias for web and app shells.

proof.$description: Evidence and receipt state alias. Must be paired with text labels.

radius.$description: Overlay radius alias. Do not introduce a project-specific radius scale.

displayFont.$description: Self-hosted variable display face embedded by the app; never substitute Helvetica.

dataFont.$description: Self-hosted face for labels, state, time, and evidence metadata.
